messages:
jen: Heads-up  i'm opening a small PR to refresh the quickstart guide: simplify auth setup, make the CLI/curl steps fully copy-pastable, add a short js sdk example using the new import surface, and fix two broken anchors in the deploy section. will tag reviewers shortly.

leo: thanks jen. which anchors are broken? i ran into one while walking a new hire through the guide.

jen: the model-catalog anchor moved and the telemetry section anchor was renamed. i'll replace both with direct file anchors and add a note about telemetry defaults. also adding an explicit `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` line near the top.

nina: can we keep curl first (super copy/paste friendly) and then a tiny node example? also add a one-line about token scopes for new orgs.

jen: yep. planned curl snippet (single line so people can paste):

`curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-qa","prompt":"Hello"}'`

jen: node snippet (minimal, uses new package name):

`import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-qa', prompt: 'Hello' }).then(r => console.log(r.text));`

leo: tiny nit: show async/await variant too? some folks prefer that.

jen: added both. also adding a quick troubleshooting blurb: common CORS error on first deploy -> check public origin, ensure CLI deploy uses `--public` flag in examples.

nina: please add a short note for Dedicated customers to pin model versions (`model: redwood/fast-qa@v1.2.0`) so they don't get surprise changes. small config snippet is helpful.

jen: added. i'll also clarify telemetry opt-in: default is opt-out for new orgs, link to privacy page, and show what minimal event types we collect.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4227  title: "Quickstart: slim auth + copyable curl/js + link anchor fixes" (author: jen)

leo: i'll review now and leave inline comments for wording and the deploy example flags. aiming to approve today so microsite picks up the change. :rocket:
